title: Imperfect Past — Regular Verbs
module: Módulo 6 — Hábitos, comparações e descrições do passado

student.lets_begin: Produce at least five accurate sentences and answer at least three questions on the topic “Habits you had several years ago” using this lesson’s target structure.
student.basic_rule: Regular imperfect shows habitual or ongoing past situations: -ava for -ar, -ia for -er/-ir.
student.english_comparison: English used to and was...ing often correspond, depending on context.

model_sentences.en: I used to study at night.
We used to live near the school.
They used to work on Saturdays.
Did you use to drink coffee?

multiple_choice.instruction: Choose one option for each meaning; say the chosen sentence aloud.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “I used to study at night.”?
Which sentence expresses “We used to live near the school.”?
Which sentence expresses “She used to eat early.”?
Which sentence expresses “They used to work on Saturdays.”?

gap_fill.instruction: Complete the missing target form. The English meaning is provided to remove ambiguity; read each whole sentence aloud.

items.hint: I used to study at night.
We used to live near the school.
They used to work on Saturdays.

mini_reading.instruction: Read the text aloud. Then answer the questions in full sentences.
mini_reading.text: Quando eu era criança, eu estudava perto de casa. Minha irmã estudava na mesma escola. Nós caminhávamos juntos todas as manhãs. Meu pai trabalhava no centro e minha mãe preparava o almoço. À noite, eu lia livros e conversava com meus amigos. Aquela rotina era simples e tranquila.
questions: Onde o narrador estudava quando era criança?
O que o narrador fazia à noite?
O que você estudava na escola?

review.another_way_to_understand_it: Use past routines rather than single finished events.

examples.en: They used to work on Saturdays.
Did you use to drink coffee?
I used to learn Portuguese at school.

review.compare: Eu estudo agora / Eu estudava antes: now versus past habit.

common_mistakes.explanation: A single finished event takes the perfect.

oral_substitution_drill.instruction: Start from the base sentence. Say the new sentence in Portuguese for the English cue, without writing it first.

items.cue: They used to work on Saturdays.
Did you use to drink coffee?
I used to learn Portuguese at school.

translate.instruction: Translate into Portuguese and say each sentence aloud.
items: They used to work on Saturdays.
Did you use to drink coffee?

fill_in.instruction: Fill the missing form in a two-clause context; say both sentences together. The English hint gives the meaning of the second sentence.

Você bebia café? Eles ________ aos sábados.
items.hint: They used to work on Saturdays.

items.sentence: Eu aprendia português na escola. Você ________ café?
items.hint: Did you use to drink coffee?

listen_and_translate.instruction: Listen to three short utterances read by your teacher. Say the meaning in English, then repeat each utterance aloud.

reading_aloud_and_translation.instruction: Read the text aloud, translate it orally into English, then answer the questions.
reading_aloud_and_translation.text: Há alguns anos, Ana morava perto do trabalho. Ela acordava cedo, tomava café e caminhava até o escritório. Os colegas almoçavam juntos todos os dias. Depois do expediente, Ana estudava português. Nos fins de semana, ela visitava os pais e ajudava na casa deles.
questions: Onde Ana morava há alguns anos?
O que Ana fazia nos fins de semana?

speaking_practice.instruction: Answer in order: factual answers first, then personal examples and explanations. All answers are spoken in full sentences.

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Which sentence expresses “I used to study at night.”? A. Nós morávamos perto da escola. B. Ela comia cedo. C. Eu estudava à noite.
A_multiple_choice.worked_answer: C. Eu estudava à noite. — compare the exact meaning, then read it aloud.

B_gap_fill.instruction: Eu ________ à noite. (I used to study at night.)
B_gap_fill.worked_answer: estudava → Eu estudava à noite. — use the English hint and the rest of the sentence.

C_english_to_portuguese.worked_answer: Ela comia cedo. — identify the subject, choose the verb form, then say it.

D_portuguese_to_english.worked_answer: I used to study at night. — translate the meaning, not word for word.

E_reading_comprehension.instruction: Onde o narrador estudava quando era criança?
E_reading_comprehension.worked_answer: Ele estudava perto de casa. — find the sentence in the text that gives the answer, then answer in a full sentence.

G_speaking.instruction: Say one sentence with today’s structure about your own life.

E_reading.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences.
E_reading.text: Antes, Pedro trabalhava aos sábados e estudava à noite. Ele comia cedo porque tinha pouco tempo. A irmã dele morava em outra cidade e telefonava aos domingos. Os amigos conversavam pela internet. Hoje a rotina é diferente, mas Pedro ainda gosta de estudar.

F_written_production.instruction: Write 80–120 words on the topic “Habits you had several years ago”. Use at least three different relevant examples of the target structure; add context and original details.

G_speaking.instruction: Record one uninterrupted spoken response to these three lesson prompts — O que você estudava na escola? / Onde você morava antes? / Você trabalhava aos sábados? — giving complete sentences and without reading a script.

F_written_production.assessment: Check length, topic relevance, at least three accurate uses of the target structure, and agreement. Personal details vary.

homework.acceptable_alternatives: A different accurate subject, name, or everyday example is acceptable in open speaking/writing tasks. For closed translation tasks, accept semantically equivalent natural Brazilian Portuguese with the target structure.
